title: 10 Hard Questions Christians Should Ask Themselves (But Won’t)

top_liked.author: @WatuYeza
top_liked.text: Pope Francis didn't go to Lourdes, in the hope of being cured, he went to a modern hospital where modern scientific understanding is keeping him alive and not an invisible deity.

top_liked.author: @Withoutfaith-i8d
top_liked.text: My children don’t need faith to know I’m their mom. If I even suspect they need me , I’m there for them, no begging or prayer needed.

top_liked.text: The last question is the greatest one of all. If there is a god who wants me to have a relationship with him, or just believe in him and do what he tells me to, the very least he could do is show up.

Also, never understood why I should hate groups of people I didn’t even know, this…
